title: Coeval
summary: COEVAL, adjective Of the same age; beginning to exist at the same time; of equal age; usually and properly followed by with. COEVAL, noun One of the same age; one who begins to exist at the same time.

inlines.v: COEVAL, adjective Of the same age; beginning to exist at the same time; of equal age; usually and properly followed by with. COEVAL, noun One of the same age; one who begins to exist at the same time. It is not properly used as synonymous with cotemporary.
